manualReview: Apply Documentation Policy's optional task-profile discovery; verify declared scope and pass applicable profiles to delegates without requiring their presence or inferring approval.
Resolve every conflict with existing policies or approved designs directly with the maintainer before dependent edits.
Verify approval for potentially unintended consequences and every policy or design decision change.

Apply all six Development Policy approval fields, a direct decision question and policy link to every approval or conflict-resolving clarification; independently review the exact request and obtain root review before sending; a rejected or withdrawn question grants no approval.

Verify every maintainer question appears in the final answer with all outstanding requests and required explanations in full; commentary, question tools, files and earlier-question references are not substitutes.

Independently review the actual final-answer implementation plan as complete readable prose; links, saved files, YAML/JSON records, ID lists and short summaries are supplementary, not delivery. This checker cannot verify conversation channels or certify that the plan was presented.

Review current implemented owners, callers, reads, writes, authority and lifecycle effects against explicit approved requirements; the frontend cutover is complete and former-frontend or past-commit comparisons are not required or permitted by the current-source amendment.
Shared files, libraries, stores or schemas do not prove unchanged responsibility; tests and agent-authored authorization records cannot supply missing maintainer approval.

Review new writable request-state mirrors, save interception, locks and common-admission writes before implementation; the configured identity-stage exception grants no permission for new callers, indirect aliases or expanded lifecycle effects.
Review comment purpose, logical spacing, readability, DRY, information hiding and existing module reuse.

Verify controllers coordinate, feature modules own shared business implementation, locked authorization stays under the lock and services remain pure DBAL; review actual shared adoption at all matching callers.
Verify established behavior and run the cheapest appropriate production checks.
